kjv: leave but the sixth part of thee (Gog)
note: The hapax shishshe'tikha was linked by KJV to shesh "six" ("leave a sixth"); it is now generally taken as "lead/drive along" (cf. Ethiopic and the parallel verbs), so there is no sixth surviving.

kjv: it (the valley) shall stop the [noses] of the passengers
mine: It (the valley) will block the travelers
note: hosemet hi et-ha'overim means "it blocks the travellers" (the mass grave obstructs the route); KJV supplied "noses" (italicised) to make it a stench.

kjv: After that they (Israel) have borne their shame
note: venasu can be from nasa (bear) with lost aleph or from nashah (forget); the time clause "when they dwell securely" suits forgetting rather than bearing shame afterward.
